title: User Signup with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can successfully sign up using valid email, password, and required fields.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup page
Input valid email, strong password, and required user information
Submit the signup form
Confirm user account is created and user is redirected to dashboard or welcome screen

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that existing users can log in with valid email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter correct email and password
Click login button
Verify successful login and access to user dashboard

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Password
description: Verify login is denied when user inputs an incorrect password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid email and incorrect password
Attempt to login
Verify error message is displayed and login denied

title: Password Reset Flow
description: Verify user can request password reset and successfully update password via the reset link.

steps.description: Navigate to the forgot password page
Input registered email and submit password reset request
Verify password reset email is sent to user
Open the reset link from email and enter a new valid password
Submit new password
Confirm password is updated and user can login with new password

title: Secure Session Management and Logout
description: Validate that user sessions are managed securely and user can logout properly.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials
Verify session is created and secured with Supabase Auth including Row Level Security
Click the logout button
Verify session is destroyed and user is redirected to login page

title: Initiate Live Voice Booking via Demo
description: Test that customers can initiate a voice-based booking via the live demo interface and complete the booking flow successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the live demo voice agent page
Enable microphone and grant WebRTC permissions
Start voice interaction and provide booking details (date, time, service)
Verify AI agent understands natural language and confirms the entered booking details
Confirm booking with AI agent
Verify booking appears in the booking system and Google Calendar is synced
Verify confirmation notification is sent to customer

title: Handle Booking Attempt for Unavailable Slot
description: Verify the AI voice agent correctly identifies and responds when the requested booking time is unavailable.

steps.description: Initiate a voice booking with a time slot that is fully booked
Verify AI agent informs customer of unavailability
Receive alternate available time suggestions from AI agent
Verify customer can select alternate booking and booking completes successfully

title: Booking Update and Cancellation from Owner Portal
description: Validate that business owners can update booking details (change time/date/status) and cancel bookings correctly, with system syncing updates.

steps.description: Login as business owner
Navigate to booking list or calendar view
Select an existing active booking
Modify booking details (e.g. reschedule date/time or change status to canceled)
Save changes
Verify booking updates are reflected in UI and synced with Google Calendar
Verify notifications related to booking update/cancellation are sent

title: Booking Filtering and Export
description: Verify bookings can be filtered by date, status, or service and that filtered results can be exported.

steps.description: Access booking management page
Apply filters such as date range, booking status, and service type
Confirm displayed bookings match filter criteria
Export filtered bookings using export functionality
Verify exported file contains correct booking data matching filters

title: Google Calendar OAuth Integration
description: Test business owner can connect their Google Calendar account via OAuth successfully and permissions are granted to sync bookings.

steps.description: Login as business owner
Go to integrations settings and select Google Calendar connection
Complete OAuth flow with Google account selection and permission grant
Verify OAuth tokens are stored securely
Confirm bookings created or updated are reflected in Google Calendar in near real-time

title: AI Voice Agent Latency and Accuracy
description: Verify that the AI voice assistant responds within 2 seconds and the transcription provided is accurate compared to spoken input.

steps.description: Start a sample voice interaction with the AI assistant
Speak a complex booking query or natural conversation
Measure response latency and ensure AI answers within 2 seconds
Compare AI transcription with actual spoken words for accuracy

title: Call History Access and Transcript Search
description: Ensure business owners can view call logs, access recordings, read transcripts, search call content, and export data.

steps.description: Login as business owner and navigate to call history page
Verify call recordings and transcripts are listed with linking to associated bookings
Search call transcripts using keywords
Confirm call entries shown match the search query
Export call history or transcripts data
Verify exported data contains complete call log and transcript information

title: Analytics Dashboard Data Accuracy and Refresh
description: Verify analytics metrics including revenue, booking counts, call performance, and customer insights are accurate and update in near real-time.

steps.description: Generate sample bookings, calls, and revenue events
Access analytics dashboard
Verify metrics accurately reflect generated data
Wait and refresh view to simulate real-time updates
Confirm dashboard metrics refresh and update according to new data

title: Business Settings Save and Apply
description: Check that changes to business info, availability, scheduling policies, and notifications in settings are saved and applied correctly.

steps.description: Login as business owner and navigate to business settings page
Modify business info such as timezone, currency, language
Configure availability schedules and notification preferences
Save changes
Verify changes persist after page reload and take effect in booking system behavior

title: Configure AI Assistant and Knowledge Base
description: Verify owners can add URLs, fetch and summarize web content to train AI knowledge base, improving AI responses.

steps.description: Navigate to AI assistant and knowledge base configuration page
Add a new URL for content extraction using available modes (single page, deep, crawl)
Trigger fetching and summarization of content
Verify content is summarized and added to knowledge base
Test AI assistant responses incorporate updated knowledge base context

title: AI Integrations Configuration and API Key Validation
description: Verify that business owners can configure AI providers with API keys, select models, and assign features successfully.

steps.description: Access AI integrations configuration page
Enter valid API keys for OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic
Select AI models and assign feature roles
Save the configuration
Verify configurations are saved and API keys validated

title: Responsive UI and WebRTC Microphone Access
description: Confirm the UI is responsive across supported browsers and microphone access is properly requested and granted for WebRTC voice agent.

steps.description: Open the voice agent demo page in various supported browsers and device viewports
Verify UI adapts correctly to different screen sizes
Trigger microphone permission request via WebRTC
Confirm microphone access prompt appears and permission granted
Verify voice agent records audio input correctly after permission

title: System HTTPS and Environment Configuration
description: Verify that the system operates exclusively over HTTPS in production environment and required environment variables are correctly configured.

steps.description: Deploy or run system in production mode
Verify all backend and frontend traffic is served over HTTPS
Verify environment variables for APIs (OpenAI, Google, Supabase) are set and loaded
Ensure no sensitive credentials or tokens appear in client side code

title: Error Handling for Missing or Invalid API Keys
description: Validate system behavior and user notifications when AI or Google Calendar API keys are missing or invalid.

steps.description: Configure AI or Google integrations with invalid or empty API keys
Attempt AI voice agent interaction or booking calendar sync
Verify meaningful error messages are shown to the owner/user
Ensure system gracefully handles request failures without crashing

title: Simultaneous Booking Requests Handling
description: Test system behavior under simultaneous booking requests to the same time slot to ensure no double bookings occur.

steps.description: Start two or more voice booking sessions requesting the same time slot concurrently
Verify only one booking succeeds and others are prompted with availability conflict
Confirm bookings are atomic and Google Calendar sync maintains consistency
